hooks.command: if [ -d .beads ] || [ -d "$HOME/.beads" ]; then IN_PROGRESS=$(bd list --status=in_progress 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'workflow-\|beads-' || true); COMMITS=$(git log --oneline --since='4 hours ago' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$COMMITS" -gt 0 ] && [ "$IN_PROGRESS" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'WARNING: This session made commits but has NO beads issues. Work should be tracked.'; fi; bd list --status=in_progress 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo '---'; echo 'Reminder: bd close <id> for completed work'; fi
